Bill.BriefDescription: Protecting salmon and steelhead spawning beds.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to salmon and steelhead spawning beds; and addinga new section to chapter 77.95 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.95 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department shall produce educational materials discouragingactivities that harm or disturb the spawning beds of salmon andsteelhead. Discouraged activities to be addressed in the educationalmaterials include, but are not limited to: Wading on spawning beds;driving motor vehicles on spawning beds; use of highpowered jet orpropellerdriven boats across spawning beds; dragging anchors throughspawning beds; digging or removing gravel from spawning beds; or anyother physical disturbance capable of disturbing spawning fish ordamaging or destroying nests of incubating eggs. (2) The educational materials must include, at a minimum, brochuresfor distribution to persons applying for fishing and boating licensesstatewide. The department must also distribute the brochures widely toretail outlets that cater to outdoor recreation. p. 1 SB 5876 (3) The department shall work cooperatively with the tribal fisherycomanagers in the development of the educational materials. (4) The department shall report to the legislature concerning theeffectiveness of this section after at least two spawning cycles ofsalmon and steelhead have occurred following the initiation ofdistribution of the educational materials. However, the report must beprovided by December 1, 2012, at the latest.
